_comment: District branding (name + hex color) joined onto the QGIS geometry during `pnpm export-layers`, keyed by the DXF entity `handle`. The CAD/DXF source carries no district names or palette colors, so they live here; the polygon geometry stays source-of-truth in QGIS. Colors are sampled from the print map legend (j26_karta_tryck-6.pdf). The handle→name mapping was guessed by location and is UNVERIFIED — the CAD layer is 'Stadsdelar försl 2' (proposal 2) and may not match the final print districts; handle 102626 centres west of the map bounds (likely a stray rectangle). Verify each polygon on the map and correct below. Re-digitizing a district in CAD changes its handle; update the key (the export warns on unmatched handles).
